testInstructions: Launch the already-built x64 Debug PowerToys.exe.
Open Settings > General and verify the main PowerToys tray icon setting describes only the main tray icon.
Open Mouse Without Borders settings, enable the theme-adaptive tray icon, and verify the icon changes with Windows light/dark theme.
Disable the setting and verify tray refresh still works when WMI theme monitoring is unavailable; repeat enabling/disabling to exercise listener disposal and bitmap refresh.
